# Packages

## Our packages

Oxinfer developed several packages to work with the OMOP Common Data Model:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cran.r-project.org"))
# db <- tools::CRAN_package_db()
print(here::here())
source(here::here("packages", "scrapePackages.R"))
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
readr::read_csv(here::here("packages", "packages.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$dev == "ox") |>
  dplyr::select(!"dev") |>
  purrr::pmap(\(package_name, organisation) {
    summarisePackage(pkg = package_name, org = organisation)
  }) |>
  paste0(collapse = "\n\n") |>
  cat()
```
